liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Playing In The Band** (2 reviews): Reviewer finds the Playin' especially nice; The rambling, jazzy Playing in the Band stood out as inspiring [5][8]
- **The Music Never Stopped** (1 review): Reviewer finds The Music Never Stopped really good here [16]
- **Bertha** (1 review): The band plays with tremendous intensity on Bertha [7]
- **The Wheel** (1 review): The transition from Drums into The Wheel remains moving for the reviewer [8]
- **Wharf Rat** (1 review): Wharf Rat is described as heavy and powerful [7]
- **Brokedown Palace** (1 review): This was the last Brokedown Palace until 12/26/79 [9]

## The recordings

- **gd1977-10-14.sbd.fixed.miller.110419.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 21 songs; 179 min; rated 4.64/5 by 11 [1]
- **gd77-10-14.sbd.gorinsky.6693.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 162 min; rated 2.79/5 by 14 [3]. Said about its sound: Sound quality is excellent throughout, apart from a glitch during the Wharf Rat into Around and Around transition; Reviewer says the sound isn't optimal, with some hiss; turning up the volume helps [5][7]
- **gd1977-10-14.sbd.miller.110400.flac16**: soundboard; 21 songs; 179 min; rated 4.33/5 by 9 [2]
- **gd1977-10-14.sbd.gorinsky.tetzeli.fix-6693.34260.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 161 min [4]

## Around the show

- Hofheinz Pavilion is on the University of Houston campus [11]
- You enter at the top of the arena with the stage below you [11]
- The encore was Brokedown Palace followed by a Playin' In The Band reprise [1]
- Reviewer played the 10-29, 11-2 and 11-4 shows from this tour leg more often than this one [10]
- Reviewer notes the band also played a strong 72 show at this Houston venue [12]
- Like 11-2-77, only part of this show got an official release; 11-2 appeared as Dick's Picks Vol. 34 [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1977-10-14.sbd.fixed.miller.110419.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat -> CD [1]. Also: This fixed version repairs a skip in Good Lovin' found on shnid 110400, with seamless disc changes [1]
- **gd77-10-14.sbd.gorinsky.6693.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [3]. Also: Reviewer had a mid-80s cassette of the second set, recopied several times, which degraded the sound [8]
- **gd1977-10-14.sbd.miller.110400.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat [2]
- **gd1977-10-14.sbd.gorinsky.tetzeli.fix-6693.34260.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Bill Golden, G. Gorinsky, and Bill Tetzeli; source: SBD>MC>R>DAT>CDR [4]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by johnsdeadart.blogspot.com: [John's Custom Grateful Dead Album Cover Art](https://johnsdeadart.blogspot.com/2017/05/blog-post_6.html) [18]
